name: Trash Garbage and Linen Chutes and Chute Systems
details:
Vertical garbage and linen chute systems for multi-storey buildings, allowing floor-level disposal to a central collection point at the base.

System overview
• Garbage chute: Floor doors discharge to a ground-level compactor or dumpster
• Linen chute: Sends soiled linen from floor pantries to a central laundry collection point

Specifications (typical project example)
• Chute tube: Dia 24″, 1.50mm SS 304 with sound-deadening material
• Doors: 1.50mm SS 304 per floor; door size 57 × 73 cm; net opening 45 × 45 cm; ~30 L capacity; bottom hinged with electromagnetic lock and indicator; 8.00mm SS 304 rod handle; 2″ × 48 kg glass wool door insulation
• Ventilation: Axial fan, 1500 CFM at terminal
• Mounting: MS frame 1.5″ × 1.5″ × 5.00mm angle; MS ring 3″ × 5.00mm flat
• Controls: Delta PLC panel (24″ × 36″ MS powder-coated) with floor status indication, lock/unlock interlocking, individual floor operation, and water-jet clean system
• Cleaning / fire: Jet/booster pump with nozzles and piping; fire sprinkler points per floor as per drawings

Door count, diameter, and electrical package are engineered to each building. Installation, commissioning, and cable laying available as a complete package.
